messages:
hannah: Getting alerts that SCIM provisioning started failing for multiple customers after yesterday's OIDC client rotation. Users not created and role assignments 403.

ryan-idp: Error samples?

hannah: From customer tenant logs: 403 unauthorized_client when calling /scim/v2/Users. Looks like our client_id was rejected.

jess-iam: Did the client secret rotate too? We rolled new client creds but set old one to expire at 02:00UTC. Some dedicated tenants still using old config.

okta-bot: automated note: OIDC client rotation completed for org-ops at 2026-03-20T02:01:12Z :white_check_mark:

hannah: Example proxied request header: 
```
Authorization: Bearer eyJhbGci... (valid access token)
client_id: 0oa1xOLDID
```
IdP responds: `{"error":"unauthorized_client","error_description":"Client not found"}`

ryan-idp: That means token was minted for old client id which IdP no longer recognizes. Could be downstream service that caches client config (eg. mesh sidecar).

infra-bot: deploy event: service/connector-config-cache at 2026-03-20T02:03:00Z rolled with new env var CLIENT_ID=0oa1xNEWID

jess-iam: Aha — the connector cache rollout flipped to new client_id but some pods still had old env due to rolling.maxUnavailable=0 for safety, so a few replicas held old value longer. If requests were sticky to those pods, they'd present old client_id when minting tokens.

hannah: That explains why failures are intermittent and tenant-scoped. But why 403 on SCIM calls? Token should still be valid if minted by old client?

ryan-idp: Okta treats client deletion as revoking client credentials; tokens minted by deleted clients can be rejected depending on token_introspection policy. Also our SCIM endpoint validates aud/client_id in introspection.

jess-iam: Immediate fix: re-add the old client_id as a temporary alias in IdP and re-enable its credential for 12 hours; then plan coordinated rollout. I'm going to open change request now.

hannah: Can we add an audit rule to detect sudden spike in unauthorized_client from a single service? Also alert on SCIM patch failures >0.5% for prod customers.

infra-bot: ticket created: INFRA-2345 add audit alert for unauthorized_client spikes and SCIM failure rate threshold.

ryan-idp: Longer-term: update connector to fetch client config from central config API instead of envvars, and add canary for client rotation where old client remains valid until 100% cutover.

jess-iam: Also need RBAC reconciliation: some role assignments were partially applied before failures and left in inconsistent state. We'll run an idempotent backfill to reconcile roles from authoritative source. Plan: 1) stop SCIM writes, 2) run dry-run reconcile, 3) apply fixes, 4) verify audit logs.

hannah: I'll coordinate customer comms and provide postmortem once we confirm root cause. For now doing the IdP alias and increasing rollout parallelism to avoid stale envs.

ryan-idp: One more note — check KMS logs for any secret access errors around rotation window; if secret fetch failed some replicas might have read empty client secret and produced invalid tokens.

jess-iam: Good call. I'll check KMS audit trail and attach to the ticket.

hannah: thanks team. Reassigning to jess-iam for the IdP alias and to infra for connector config change. Will update thread when done :thumbsup:
